verdict.rationale: Algolia's own search analytics docs name all three metrics the story asks for: popular searches, no-results queries, and click-through rates. The docs also cover dashboard export, period comparison mode, and click tracking. A community user independently praises the analytics for tying queries to purchases. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the no-result and click-through reports specifically, and documentation of what click-event instrumentation is needed to populate click-through metrics.

support.subject: As a founder, built-in analytics show top queries, no-result queries, and click-through so I know what users search for and miss

citations.quote: Search analytics offer insights into what your users search and which results they select through metrics such as popular searches, no results, and click-through rates.
Analytics - Search analytics, click tracking, A/B testing, and conversion metrics
To export any of the metrics from the Algolia dashboard, click Download.
